dj.line:
Eight million three hundred eighty-eight thousand six hundred eight on the fee dial isn't a number, it's a lever — and somebody just handed the house the handle mid-hand. You sit down thinking you know the rake; you don't even know who's holding it.

So tell me, friend — when the take changes between your bet and the river, who exactly is the mark at this table?
